companyFieldUpdates.name: Harvestone Low Carbon Partners
companyFieldUpdates.description: Harvestone Low Carbon Partners, LP is a U.S. low-carbon fuels and carbon-management platform formed in 2022 by ECP and Harvestone Group. ECP attributes the investment to ECP Fund V, and both partners continue to identify the platform as active; exact stakes, control and holding vehicles are not publicly disclosed. Through HLCP Ethanol Holdco, the platform acquired Midwest AgEnergy, including Blue Flint and Dakota Spirit and its 40% Coal Creek interest, and also acquired Iroquois Bio-Energy. Those facilities, subsidiaries and project entities remain subordinate to the manager-level platform. The three dry-mill biorefineries produce approximately 215 million gallons of ethanol, 490,000 tons of distillers grains and 9.6 million gallons of corn oil annually, while Blue Flint stores approximately 220,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide. Bank of America's September 2024 US$205 million Blue Flint CCS tax-equity investment is project financing rather than platform ownership. No later platform sale, sponsor exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
